name: taxon
title: Taxon
description: A group of organisms (sensu http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_0100026) considered by taxonomists to form a homogeneous unit.
rdfs:comment: A group of organisms (sensu http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_0100026) considered by taxonomists to form a homogeneous unit.

fields.name: taxon_pk
fields.title: Taxon (Primary Key)
fields.description: A unique identifier for an ltc:Taxon.
fields.comments: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to guarantee uniqueness.
fields.rdfs:comment: A unique identifier for an ltc:Taxon.

fields.name: objectGroup_fk
fields.title: Object Group (Foreign Key)
fields.comments: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key).
fields.rdfs:comment: This property refers to one or more related instances of the Taxon class.

fields.name: genus
fields.title: Genus
fields.description: The full scientific name of the genus in which the taxon is classified.
fields.comments: The full scientific name of the genus in which the collection's taxa are classified.
fields.rdfs:comment: The full scientific name of the genus in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

fields.name: kingdom
fields.title: Kingdom
fields.description: The full scientific name of the kingdom in which the taxon is classified.
fields.comments: The full scientific name of the kingdom in which the taxa in the collection are classified. Examples of controlled vocabularies include http://tdwg.github.io/ontology/ontology/voc/Collection.rdf and https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0130114 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Two-empire_system.
fields.rdfs:comment: The full scientific name of the kingdom in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

fields.name: scientificName
fields.title: Scientific Name
fields.description: The full scientific name, with authorship and date information if known. When forming part of an Identification, this should be the name in lowest level taxonomic rank that can be determined. This term should not contain identification qualifications, which should instead be supplied in the IdentificationQualifier term.
fields.comments: The full scientific name. This should be the name in lowest level taxonomic rank that applies across the collection. If this field is used, then recommended to also complete the taxonRank. This term should not contain identification qualifications.
fields.examples: `Coleoptera` (order), `Vespertilionidae` (family), `Manis` (genus), `Ctenomys sociabilis` (genus + specificEpithet), `Ambystoma tigrinum diaboli` (genus + specificEpithet + infraspecificEpithet)
fields.rdfs:comment: The full scientific name, with authorship and date information if known. When forming part of a dwc:Identification, this should be the name in lowest level taxonomic rank that can be determined.

fields.name: taxonRank
fields.title: Taxon Rank
fields.description: The taxonomic rank of the most specific name in the scientificName.
fields.comments: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary. For example: https://bioportal.bioontology.org/ontologies/TAXRANK?p=summary
fields.rdfs:comment: The taxonomic rank of the most specific name in the dwc:scientificName.
